# phare_uptime_heartbeats (Data Source)

Fetches a list of uptime heartbeats, optionally filtered by tags.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phare_uptime_heartbeats" "all" {}

data "phare_uptime_heartbeats" "production" {
  tags = ["environment:production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_scope` (Dynamic) Optional. Project scope for this data source. Accepts either a numeric project ID (e.g., 123) or a string project slug (e.g., "my-project"). Overrides the provider-level project_scope if set. Required when using an organization-scoped API key (starting with pha_org_).
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags to filter heartbeats, only the heartbeats having all the tags are returned. If not specified, returns all heartbeats (first page, up to 100 heartbeats).

### Read-Only

- `heartbeats` (Attributes List) List of uptime heartbeats (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--heartbeats))

<a id="nestedatt--heartbeats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `heartbeats`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp
- `display_name` (String) Public name of the heartbeat on status pages, null when it defaults to the heartbeat name
- `grace` (Number) Time allowed after an expected ping before it counts as missed, in seconds
- `id` (Number) Heartbeat ID
- `incident_confirmations` (Number) Number of uninterrupted missed or failed pings required to create an incident
- `interval` (Number) Expected time between two pings, in seconds
- `last_pinged_at` (String) Date of the last successful or failed ping with a 1 minute accuracy, null until the first ping
- `name` (String) Heartbeat name
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the heartbeat is paused
- `ping_url` (String, Sensitive) URL to request with GET, HEAD or POST when the job succeeds, add /start when it begins and /fail to report a failure
- `project_id` (Number) Parent project ID
- `recovery_confirmations` (Number) Number of uninterrupted successful pings required to resolve an incident
- `status` (String) Current heartbeat status (waiting, online, offline or paused)
- `tags` (Set of String) Resource tags
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp
